variants.headline: Still in view: company lays off many workers
variants.sub: Many workers have been laid off by a company in the colony.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A company has laid off many workers in {colony}.

The conduct of {target} deserves scrutiny in relation to the layoff. This paper does not presume a financial cause, a compensation arrangement or the subsequent circumstances of those whose employment has been affected.

variants.headline: Still in view: a large loss of jobs at a company
variants.sub: The colony has seen a company carry out a large layoff.
variants.body:

variants.headline: Still in view: workers face a company layoff

variants.body:
